MGM_2016_p62__paragraph_0.ocr:

of disposition on November 23, 2015 and the results of Borgata through the date of acquisition on August 1,
2016. The results of Crystals, including the gain on sale recognized in 2016, are classified as discontinued
operations in the summarized results of operations for all periods presented.
